svg.text: Four layers every major jurisdiction now shares
Each layer answers a different question. A framework is only as strong as its weakest layer.

g.text: Who can complain, and on what basis
150+ states recognise the right. Children's rights bodies and regional courts read it as implicit in existing treaties.
What the site must achieve, and under what permit
EU IED 2010/75/EU as amended by 2024/1785 and its BAT conclusions, US 40 CFR 60 Subpart OOO opacity limits,
national action plans and lender standards such as the IFC Performance Standards.
How a source with no duct is made accountable
Certified visible emission observation (EPA Method 9), fence-line and community PM10 / PM2.5 with local wind data,
and camera-based recognition — which must be able to separate a dust plume from a steam plume.
What is physically installed, and when it runs
Dry fog at enclosed transfer points, fog cannons over open areas, wheel cleaning at the gate, and a control layer
that links all three to live dust and wind data. Suppression without sweeping only postpones the problem.
